claim_boundary: Passing this gate supports only the frozen buyer-authorized population evaluated under this protocol; it is not a universal production-accuracy claim.

Confidence intervals, abstentions, unresolved truth, reviewer disagreement, false-positive dollars, false-negative dollars, incumbent leakage and duplicate leakage must remain visible rather than being collapsed into a single accuracy percentage.
AUDIT_QUALITY_PROVEN does not mean realized recovery. Carrier action, settlement, reversal and fee eligibility remain separate externally evidenced states.
Synthetic fixtures may validate this methodology implementation but may not satisfy the external customer-proof gate.
